Real NotificationOutbox retains one row. Durable _observe also keys by id, so the second run loses its required owner alert. Include project/REQ/task in blocked identity; no foreign-user exploit is alleged.

findings.summary: Failure reviews identify an attempt globally even though attempt ids are local to a run.
findings.evidence: New Probe AA: exit 0; real independent M1 runs demo/REQ-001 and demo/REQ-002 both have failed att-0001 with distinct causes. Actual _failure_review(att-0001), using real run discovery and attempt facts, returns REQ-001 cause; the phone selecting REQ-002 sends the same /attempts/att-0001/review URL and labels that response with its selected REQ/task. The route accepts no run identity, so it cannot choose REQ-002 evidence and may instead return 404 if the first match is not failed. Namespace the API/query by run and validate the selected target. Same owner scope; no cross-user disclosure is claimed.

findings.summary: A newly created question round on an old plan is immediately dropped as expired before any Telegram send.
findings.evidence: New Probe AC: exit 0; actual bt_rounds.new_round creates an open round now on a fixture whose PLAN.md timestamp is two hours old. Real plans_payload and feed.collect assign the plan updated_at to round.waiting instead of the round creation time. Actual GatewayRuntime._poll_events -> NotificationOutbox.deliver_due records dropped/expired at attempt 0, sender receives nothing. A fresh required R10 owner event is therefore permanently lost even though its cursor is delivered (F55 fixed). Preserve truthful event creation time and restored message expiry; do not undo the one-hour drop.

findings.summary: The routes endpoint lists unknown-quota routes as available while retry refuses those same candidates.
findings.evidence: New Probe AD: exit 0; one synthetic candidate with valid authorization/runtime/source and quota_status=unknown is listed available by actual bt_remote_recovery.route_options, but actual bt_route_pins.available with identical candidate/route returns []. The former checks quota != exhausted; the latter requires quota == available. No actual account/quota source was read. Use the same availability rule; refusal is safe but contradicts the selectable route list.

findings.summary: The local panel cannot start on Linux without systemctl after the new ownership guard.
findings.evidence: New Probe AE: exit 0; with Linux, no running panel and subprocess.run raising FileNotFoundError for missing systemctl, actual ensure_server treats _unit_enabled as true then tries systemctl --user restart and propagates FileNotFoundError, with zero detached starts. This changes the existing systemd-less startup path under R18. Only subprocess/platform boundaries are stubbed; no host service is started/stopped. Keep the enabled-unit ownership guard while distinguishing unavailable systemctl from an enabled service.
